title: long_read pipeline parameters
description: Ensembl long-read transcriptome annotation pipeline. Aligns long reads with minimap2, collapses transcript models, and classifies by protein support.

sample_sheet.description: Path to TSV sample sheet. Required columns: sample_name, fastq_file, instrument_platform (ONT|PACBIO_SMRT). Optional: url (for download).

genome_fasta.description: Path to unmasked reference genome FASTA (with .fai index).

genome_index.description: Path to pre-built minimap2 genome index (.mmi). If absent, one will be created from genome_fasta.

protein_db.description: Path to directory containing a pre-built blastp BLAST database (UniProt Swiss-Prot recommended).

outdir.description: Output directory. GFF3, BAM files, and output_manifest.json are written here.

minimap2_preset.description: minimap2 preset. Use 'splice' for ONT cDNA, 'splice:hq' for PacBio IsoSeq, 'map-ont'/'map-pb' for genomic.

collapse_min_overlap.description: Minimum reciprocal exon overlap fraction to collapse two transcripts into one model (0–1).

blast_evalue.description: E-value cutoff for blastp classification against the protein database.

max_intron_size.description: Maximum intron size in bp. Alignments with larger introns are filtered.

skip_download.description: Set to true if all fastq_file paths in the sample sheet are local (skip ENA/SRA download).
